items.title: Settlement Agreement
items.plain: Guarantees at least 75% of full benefits and requires annual Government payments to the Settlement Fund.

items.title: Final Judgment approving the settlement
items.plain: The federal court’s approval of the class-action settlement in Johnson v. Inos.

items.title: Order appointing the Settlement Fund Trustee
items.plain: Names the independent trustee who oversees the Fund and reports to the court.

items.title: HB 24-75 — retiree health insurance
items.plain: Proposes $2.8 million for group health and life insurance, leaving a $4.4 million gap.

items.title: Fund to Secretary of Finance re GHLI
items.plain: The Fund asks for modifications to the settlement agreement concerning health insurance.

items.title: Camacho v. NMI Settlement Fund
items.plain: A local Supreme Court decision involving the Fund. Plain-language summary to come.
